verifierBody:
pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ a6de4a9b9fb13817d67cae628c2204cbb257d9a7

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff implements the promised find-in-chat flow (menu row, search bar with count and up/down, case-insensitive marking, wrapping steps, newest-first start, 0 of 0, back closes and clears), and the only journey driven (session-reader.md) passes on both parent and head, so nothing regressed in the ordinary reader. But no journey ever opened search, typed a query, stepped matches or closed search, so none of the feature's promised outcomes is shown by evidence.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `session-reader.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- Journey session-reader.md passed on the parent side (driver exit 0, receipts VERIFY_INTERRUPTED_528) and on the head side (15 screenshots, DRIVER EXIT: 0), so the same journey gives no regression signal either way.
- The head driver transcript tail only shows steps 01-15 for sign-in, sessions, reader ready, attach menu, send draft, Enter, interrupt and exit; no step taps the chat menu's new 'Search in chat' row.
- The parent driver transcript tail is the same sequence and finishes with 'FEATURE VERIFIED: session-reader.md', confirming the journey is a generic reader journey, not a search journey.
- The head artifact list contains no screenshot or UI dump named for a search bar, match marking, or a count label.
- Diff in MultipromptApp.kt adds the 'Search in chat' menu row, ReaderSearchBar (back, KitSearchBox, KitMatchCount, up/down), BackHandler branch and 'searchOpen' reset, matching the description's UI promises.
- Diff in ChatFind.kt/ChatFindMarks.kt implements case-insensitive overlapping matching, wrapping step(), the 'n of m'/'0 of 0' label, and highlight painting, with searchIndex initialised to Int.MAX_VALUE so the count starts on the newest hit.
- Diff in ChatHistoryList.kt and MarkdownText.kt adds hit mapping, scrollToItem/bringIntoView for the active hit, and clearing of marks when findQuery is blank.
- app/src/test/java/dev/multiprompt/companion/ui/ChatFindTest.kt covers matching and stepping, but the description states these JVM tests were not run and no artifact in either run shows unit-test output.

Not covered:
- Opening 'Search in chat' and seeing the top bar turn into a search bar (back, box, count, up/down).
- Typing a word and seeing every already-loaded match marked, including case-insensitive matching.
- Up/down stepping, wrapping at both ends, and the chat scrolling to the current match.
- The initial count starting on the newest match and '0 of 0' for a query with no hits.
- Back button and system back closing search, restoring the normal top bar and clearing the marks.
- Search inside a history-backed chat (ChatHistoryList path) versus the tmux fallback/transcript path.

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43846441705
